summary: Self-review of Reese-max/minideck PR #47 against linked issue #40 found and fixed two medium-severity defects. Version rollback now honors and holds the shared busy lock, including refreshed buttons, and releases controls on success or failure. Successful project creation reuses resetShell to discard the previous project's deck eligibility, chat history and unsent instruction; failed creation preserves the current project. The six legacy test entrypoints and nine DOM tests pass via npm run check executed in Git Bash; tests_passed counts the nine node:test cases. README and .issue-loop-review.json describe the fixes.
